title: Alignment Effects
description: Alignment Plugin gives players  buffs or debuffs based on deaths, with effects scaling from negative to positive alignment. Players can view their alignment in a GUI using /alignment, and effects like Strength, Speed, Weakness, and Slowness
body:
Alignment Plugin introduces a tiered player alignment system to your Minecraft server, perfect for RPG-style gameplay or custom servers. Players’ alignment changes dynamically when they kill or are killed by others, influencing buffs and debuffs in a balanced and persistent system.

Features:

Dynamic PvP Alignment:
Players gain positive alignment when killing others and lose alignment when dying, affecting their gameplay experience.

Read-only GUI:
/alignment opens a custom GUI showing current alignment. Players cannot move or remove items from it.

Tiered Effects:
Alignment levels grant tiered positive or negative effects:

Positive: Speed, Strength, Jump Boost, Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Regeneration, Saturation

Negative: Weakness, Slowness, Hunger, Confusion, Mining Fatigue, Blindness
Effects scale with alignment from -1.0 to 1.0.

Persistent Alignment:
Alignment is saved automatically in alignment.yml and persists across server restarts.

Easy to Install:
Works on Paper 1.21+ servers. Simply drop the .jar in your plugins folder and reload.

Customizable & Expandable:
Designed with modular code, so server admins can easily adjust alignment increments, effects, or GUI features.

Commands:

/alignment – Opens the alignment GUI for the player.

Installation:

Download the .jar file and place it in your server's plugins folder.

Start or reload your server.

The plugin will create alignment.yml automatically.

Enjoy tiered alignment gameplay!
